concerns.text: T000 (Recovery & Reset) is listed before T050a (Create Research Document) and T050b (Implement Citation Validator). T000 logic requires 'research.md' to exist to verify it, but T050a is the task that creates it. This creates a circular dependency where the reset task cannot run until the research task runs, but the research task is part of the recovery loop. T000 must be moved to depend on T050a or split into a pre-recovery check.

T010 (Structural Validation Generator) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T007 (dataset.schema.yaml) and T008 (output.schema.yaml) implicitly via its verification step ('validate output against contracts'). T007 and T008 are listed AFTER T010 in the task list. A task cannot validate against a contract that has not yet been created. T010 must be moved after T007 and T008, or the [P] tag removed and dependencies explicitly declared.

T019 (Implement run_pipeline.py) is listed AFTER T015-T022 (Ingestion/Feature Engineering). However, T019's description states it 'orchestrates ingestion, joining, and feature engineering'. The orchestrator (T019) must be implemented BEFORE the components it orchestrates can be tested end-to-end, or at least the task order implies the components exist before the runner is built. More critically, T010a (CLI Orchestrator) is in Phase 2, but T019 (also CLI Orchestrator) is in Phase 3. This is a duplicate/contradiction in artifact creation order. T019 should be removed or merged with T010a, and T010a must precede T015-T022 to allow them to be invoked.

T017c (Spatial Join Validation) depends on T017 (Spatial Join) and T015 (Survey Collector). However, T017c also references 'data/processed/feature_engineered_data.csv' as the non-aggregated output source in T017d, but T018b (which produces this file) is listed AFTER T017c. T017c logic requires the output of T018b to exist to determine if aggregation is needed, but T018b is downstream. The validation logic (T017c) must be moved after T018b, or the logic must be split to validate raw join (T017) before feature engineering (T018b).

T085 (Initialize Re-implementation State) is placed in Phase N+6, AFTER Phase N+3, N+4, and N+5 which contain verification and execution tasks (T080, T082a-c, T090-T094). T085's logic is to 'Reset task markers for T015-T035 to [ ]'. If T085 runs after T080 (Verify & Patch) and T082 (Execute Pipeline), it will undo the state required for those tasks to pass or will reset the state of tasks that have already been verified as complete. T085 must be moved to the very beginning of the re-implementation sequence, before any verification or execution tasks.
